verses.text: And these were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: The firstborn Amnon by Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel by Abigail the Carmelitess;

verses.text: Six were born to him in Hebron, and he reigned there seven years and six months. And thirty-three years he reigned in Jerusalem.
